title: Invariant anticanonical sections with nonzero Euler characteristic
exact_target: Let X be smooth connected projective complex with smoothly semipositive $-K_X$ and $\chi (X,O_X)\neq 0$. For any algebraic torus T acting on X with the natural anticanonical linearization, must some positive anticanonical multiple have a nonzero T-invariant global section?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Cohomological transfer and equivariant anticanonical sections
